usage: Sometimes 打針 is used as a noun to refer to the act or process of receiving an injection.
You can say '去打針' which means 'go get an injection'.
打針 can also refer to the injection itself, like the medicine given through a needle.
It is common to hear people say they are afraid of 打針 because of the needle.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 daa2 zam1
examples.meaning: I need to get an injection today.
